scope.description: Named contractor associations from DIME projects, PhilGEPS v2 awarded Construction Projects, DPWH Transparency contract records and the BetterGov DPWH contract-list snapshot. PhilGEPS v2 awards are deduplicated by award identity/title/year/awardee; amount is counted once despite repeated line-item rows. Exact normalized title/year GAA matches are attached where the integrated DPWH GAA source contains a classified line. The integrated GAA baseline covers classified DPWH roads, bridges, flood-control and multi-purpose-building rows.

sourceNotes.DIME: All named contractor project rows in the local ODV DIME cache.
sourceNotes.PhilGEPS: PhilGEPS v2 typed layer (2000–2025), filtered to awarded Construction Projects with an award date and named awardee. This is an independent, unofficial normalization of published exports; repeated line-item rows and source exports are deduplicated by award identity/title/year/awardee, and amounts are taken once per award rather than summed across lines. Project type, project location, Philippine-peso denomination and wrongdoing are not established by this source.
sourceNotes.DPWH Transparency: All named contractor associations in the local DPWH Transparency cache; repeated rows are deduplicated by contract/title/year/name.
sourceNotes.DPWH contract list: BetterGov DPWH contracts Parquet, snapshot 2026-11-03, FY2016–FY2026. Individual contract descriptions, amounts, statuses, offices and DPWH source-page links are attached by exact contractor name and license parsed from the source field. Joint-venture contract rows appear under every named party, so contractor-level associations overlap and must not be summed as distinct contracts. Contract amounts are not payments; amount-paid values are displayed as reported. This source overlaps the separate DPWH Transparency parquet and is retained as its own evidence column.
sourceNotes.GAA: Exact normalized title/year links use classified project rows from integrated-project-data.json. An absent link means no exact classified row was found in that dataset, not proof that the project was unbudgeted.
sourceNotes.AMO: ODV AMO cache associations are research leads. Indirect names and SEC officers without a known direct elected-official association are masked with first/last-letter hints.

dataShardFormat: contractors-data/shard-NNN.json for project details; filter-stats-category-NNN.json and filter-stats-year-NNN.json load when those filters are used; SEC, membership, PCAB and AMO records load on request
